oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Stable Routing for Sparse Mixture of Experts under Memory Constraints
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Chen, Wei
Novak, Petra
oai_dc:dc.dc:subject: cs.LG
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: We study routing stability in sparse mixture of experts language models under constrained accelerator memory. Experiments on open Qwen checkpoints show that routing collapse can be predicted from load-balance loss curvature, enabling early intervention during training.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Scientific Literature Triage
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Haddad, Mariam
oai_dc:dc.dc:subject: cs.CL
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: We introduce an open benchmark for retrieval-augmented generation over scientific corpora, with reference implementations in PyTorch and an evaluation harness covering citation-grounded answering and abstract triage.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Foundation Models for Time-Domain Astronomy
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Okafor, Rina
oai_dc:dc.dc:subject: cs.LG
astro-ph.IM
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: We pretrain foundation models on photometric time series from public sky surveys and demonstrate transfer to transient classification and period estimation for variable stars, using only openly licensed archival data.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: KV-Cache Compression for Long-Context Inference on Commodity GPUs
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Lindqvist, Johan
oai_dc:dc.dc:subject: cs.LG
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: We propose a KV-cache compression scheme for long-context inference that integrates with vLLM and requires no retraining, evaluated on recent NVIDIA consumer accelerators with limited memory budgets.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: DeepSeek-V4 Technical Report: Scaling Sparse Attention with Mixture-of-Experts
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: DeepSeek Research
oai_dc:dc.dc:subject: cs.LG
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: We present DeepSeek-V4, combining hierarchical sparse attention with a Mixture-of-Experts backbone. The report details training stability techniques, an inference-time expert-offloading scheme, and evaluations against contemporary open baselines.

oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Evaluating Code Agents on Multi-Repository Refactoring Tasks
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Alvarez, Sofia
Tsinghua University NLP Group
oai_dc:dc.dc:subject: cs.SE
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: We evaluate code agents built on DeepSeek and Qwen model families across multi-repository refactoring tasks, finding that repository-level context selection dominates raw model capability as task horizon grows.
